quality.label_policy: Assistant-authored fresh challenge labels, frozen before inference: accept complete supported useful production details; reject contradictions and invented causes. Not independent external annotations; all cases become consumed development evidence after this run.

evidence.text: According to editor Yang Jin-mo, Bong chose to shoot the film without traditional coverage. To give them more editing options with limited shots, they sometimes stitched together different takes of the same shot.

facts.title: An edit assembled from multiple takes

facts.title: Traditional coverage throughout

evidence.text: Johnson named each of the characters after musicians whose works he enjoyed because it was a simple practice to remember—for example, Joni Mitchell, Richard Thompson, and Steely Dan's Donald Fagen.

facts.title: Musicians behind the character names
facts.text: Johnson named Knives Out characters after musicians he enjoyed, including Joni Mitchell and Steely Dan’s Donald Fagen, to make the names easier to remember.
facts.evidence_quote: Johnson named each of the characters after musicians whose works he enjoyed because it was a simple practice to remember—for example, Joni Mitchell, Richard Thompson, and Steely Dan's Donald Fagen.

facts.title: A rejected source for character names

facts.title: A soundtrack-driven naming decision

facts.evidence_quote: Johnson named each of the characters after musicians whose works he enjoyed because it was a simple practice to remember—for example, Joni Mitchell, Richard Thompson, and Steely Dan's Donald Fagen.
